snippet.title: Anomaly President - Launch Trailer (Early Access)
snippet.description:
Take down the legion of gangs and criminals of the Evil President, recruit some of the cutest extremists called Fluffies, and get your hands on a wide number of anomaly-filled weapons and powers.

This is Anomaly President. And it's now available on Steam Early Access!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156330/Anomaly_President/
